Name: Brown haired Jas and blonde Vincent update
Author: forrpa
Description:
I didnt like that the children in the game have colored hair, I want "natural" children! So I made a recolor of Jas and Vincent :) This is my first mod ever!

Credit to ConcernedApe.

Installation:
- Download file
- Extract
- Open your Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits folder and Stardew Valley\Content\Characters folder
- Back up your Vincent.xnb and Jas.xnb files that's in your Portraits and Characters folders, just in case.
- Copy my new Jas.xnb and vincent.xnb files from this download over to your Portraits and Characters Folders. (There are two files in this download, but they are in maps named portrait/character so you know which to place where)
- Enjoy the game!
